panels.title: AI request outcomes (per status)
panels.description: app.observability.ai_trace_recorder.finish_trace's status/answer_state, emitted via app.observability.otel_metrics.record_ai_request_completed. For per-request detail (question/answer/citations), use the in-app Observability dashboard - this panel is the aggregate operator view only.

panels.title: AI provider call failure rate (per provider)
panels.description: ai_model_call_total's outcome label - a sustained non-zero failure rate here is the same signal app.observability.alerts's provider_error_rate_high threshold and app.alerting's proactive delivery already evaluate; this panel is the always-on trend view of the same underlying condition.

panels.title: AI pipeline stage latency p95 (embedding / retrieval / generation / ...)
panels.description: ai_stage_latency_ms by stage - app.observability.context's fixed STAGE_* vocabulary (query_embedding, retrieval, provider_generation, etc.). This is the closest Prometheus-native equivalent to 'embedding latency' / 'retrieval latency' / 'generation latency' the platform can currently measure without a customer/tenant-identifying label.

panels.title: AI model call latency p50 / p95 (per provider/model)
Token usage rate (per provider/model)
panels.description: ai_tokens_total - recorded once per completed request from finish_trace's already-aggregated total_tokens, not per model-call attempt.

panels.title: Estimated AI spend rate (USD/s, per provider/model)
panels.description: Only populated for requests where pricing is known (ModelConfig.input_cost_per_million_tokens/output_cost_per_million_tokens are both set) - see app.observability.ai_trace_recorder.record_model_call's pricing_known flag.

panels.title: Guardrail outcomes (per layer)
panels.description: ai_guardrail_outcomes_total - see docs/architecture/guardrails.md for layers A-H. A rising blocked share on one layer is worth investigating via the in-app Observability trace detail view (guardrail reason codes), not actionable from this aggregate alone.

panels.title: Evaluation / release gate outcomes
panels.description: evaluation_gate_outcomes_total - emitted by app.operations.eval_release_gate_check (gate=release_gate) and eval_regression_report (gate=regression) alongside app.alerting's existing evaluation-gate-failure notification (app.alerting.hooks.notify_gate_failure). Same underlying verdict, two delivery paths (immediate proactive alert vs. this trend view) - see docs/architecture/observability.md's 'alert responsibility split'.
